hypothesis: Replacing each player with an absolute peer-group workload mean discarded individual workload variation. Test learning workload change relative to each player latest reconciled workload, rather than another absolute cohort mean.
target: Observed target joint workload/calendar minus the player own prior-season joint workload/prior calendar; include certified zero outcomes as negative residuals. At prediction add the estimated change to the individual prior workload vector.
fixed: Same historical source policy, baseline comparator, full comparison cohort, support floors, prior50 and deterministic pool hierarchy where applicable; no new age/chart/Statcast/minor features and no hyperparameter search.
risk: This is a point-estimate residual model, not a calibrated medical or appearance-probability model. Retain nonappearances, negative changes and uncertainty. No automatic growth increment, minimum workload floor or deletion of injury/role-loss cases.
coherence: Register component-vector construction and nonnegative joint projection rules before testing; derive pitcher G/OUTS from component partitions; do not claim full fantasy counts or team budgets are solved.
guard_prerequisite: Register a consistent pre-origin freshness ledger for both arms using certified zero-PA evidence, keeping original baseline predictions unchanged. Preserve15-row subgroup and2% thresholds. Do not retroactively relabel this failed run or call it a pass.
validation: This recommendation is informed by2023–2025 development errors. A future separately registered test must retain existing earlier-only guards and exclude2026 errors; repeated development folds are not fresh independent validation. Independent prospective evidence would still be needed.
